brief: 7 tools that turn one engineer into a team. Names, urls, why each matters.

slots.title: 1. GitHub, the Senior Dev
slots.body: Code review, version control, and seamless collaboration let you ship with confidence as if a senior engineer reviewed every commit.

slots.title: 2. Vercel, the DevOps Lead
slots.body: Instant previews, automated deployments, and global edge caching replace an entire infrastructure team with zero config.

slots.title: 3. Supabase, the Backend Team
slots.body: PostgreSQL database, auth, and real-time APIs give your app a scalable backend without hiring backend engineers.

slots.title: 4. Stripe, the Finance Ops
slots.body: Payments, invoicing, and subscription logic are handled out-of-the-box so you never need a billing department.

slots.title: 5. Linear, the Product Manager
slots.body: Issue tracking, roadmaps, and sprint planning keep your solo workflow organized like a dedicated PM.

slots.title: 6. Slack, the Team Connector
slots.body: Integrations and alerts from every tool feed into one channel so nothing slips through the cracks.

slots.headline: Build Like a Team
slots.subline: Start with these six tools and ship faster than teams triple your size.
